node.statement: Direct discharge without node 1.3.3.2: validated node 1.3.3.1 has validated registered dependencies 1.1 and 1.3.2 and proves the complete required inference. Explicitly, node 1.1 supplies D_r and C, their projection bases, the sufficiently accurate non-unital inclusions v_D and w, and v_D(I_r)=v(I_r), w(1)=Q, v_D(Pi_a)=R_a. Applying the allowed external lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity yields a linear bijection S_{v(I_r),Q} -> direct-sum_{a=1}^r S_{R_a,Q}. Taking dimensions and using node 1.3.2, dim S_{R_a,Q}=d for every a, gives dim S_{v(I_r),Q}=sum_{a=1}^r d=r*d. Hence node 1.3.3 is established directly from validated node 1.3.3.1; pending node 1.3.3.2 is redundant and is not used in this discharge.
